LEG 2 - CITED FILE:LINE: CONFIRMED. `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/managed-policy.ts:501-534` is `export const MANAGED_PI_POLICY_KEYS`, exactly 34 entries: schemaVersion, disabledPermissionModes, permissionDsl, allowedPluginKeys, deniedPluginKeys, enabledPlugins, allowedMcpServers, deniedMcpServers, allowPluginHooks, allowManagedHooksOnly, disableAllHooks, allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly, defaultMode, channelsEnabled, allowedChannelServers, sandbox, workflow, allowedHttpHookUrls, httpHookAllowedEnvVars, claudeRules, autoMode, cleanupPeriodDays, autoCompactEnabled, connectSourcesOnStartup, env, forceRemoteSettingsRefresh, requiredMinimumVersion, requiredMaximumVersion, availableModels, enforceAvailableModels, strictKnownMarketplaces, extraKnownMarketplaces. `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` is not among them, and none of the 34 locks skill or agent ORIGIN. LEG 2b - THE GREP CLAIM IS WRONG, THOUGH NOT FATALLY. `grep -rlaF strictPluginOnlyCustomization packages apps` returns FIVE files, not 'two vendored bundles under apps/electron/resources': packages/pi-agent-server/dist/index.js, apps/electron/dist/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js, apps/electron/dist/resources/session-mcp-server/index.js, apps/electron/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js, apps/electron/resources/session-mcp-server/index.js. First-party source is genuinely 0: `grep -ran strictPluginOnlyCustomization --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.json packages/*/src apps/*/src` returns nothing.

LEG 3 - ONE LAYER UP: NO UPSTREAM HANDLER. There is no second managed surface that could absorb the key. `refuseUnknownKeys` (managed-policy.ts:727-733) drops any key outside MANAGED_PI_POLICY_KEYS with disposition 'stripped', so an admin document carrying `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` is silently degraded (surfaced only by `nessy-general-agent doctor`). `managed-composition.ts` records no counterpart for it. The plugin-scope keys (`allowedPluginKeys`, `deniedPluginKeys`, `enabledPlugins`) narrow WHICH PLUGINS load; they never touch user- or project-sourced skills and agents.

LEG 3 - ONE LAYER DOWN: THE CONSEQUENCE IS INDEPENDENTLY TRUE, AND THE SUBSYSTEM IS NAMED CORRECTLY. The surfaces the doc names really do exist here and really are unlocked. correctedState:
`strictPluginOnlyCustomization` has no first-party reader. It is absent from `ManagedPiPolicyV1` and from `MANAGED_PI_POLICY_KEYS` (packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/managed-policy.ts:501-534, 34 keys), so `refuseUnknownKeys` (:727-733) strips it from an admin document with disposition 'stripped' - reported only by `nessy-general-agent doctor`, never enforced.

CORRECTION TO THE EVIDENCE: `grep -rlaF strictPluginOnlyCustomization packages apps` returns FIVE files, not two - packages/pi-agent-server/dist/index.js plus apps/electron/{,dist/}resources/{pi-agent-server,session-mcp-server}/index.js. All five are gitignored build output (.gitignore:7, :11, :12) and each carries the string exactly once, inside a vendored Claude zod schema (`union([boolean, array(enum(["skills","agents","hooks","mcp"]))])`) that is declared and never read. First-party `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` are genuinely 0.

PER-SURFACE DISPOSITION, since `true` locks four surfaces and an array locks a subset:
- `hooks` - partially covered by different mechanisms with different semantics. `allowManagedHooksOnly` (managed-policy.ts:177) is STRICTER than the doc's hooks row: it drops plugin hooks too, except those from a force-enabled plugin (see the widening-keys note at :545). `allowPluginHooks` (:1314) and `disableAllHooks` (:191) are the other two switches. No key expresses the doc's exact 'plugins and managed only' shape, but an admin can reach an equal-or-tighter state.
- `mcp` - already registered as not implemented at docs/architecture/managed-mcp-access.md:95 ('documented, not implemented - a settings key we do not carry'). `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` (managed-policy.ts:129 ff.) filter by server NAME, not by origin tier.
- `skills` and `agents` - GENUINELY OPEN, no managed control of any kind. Native skills merge three tiers in packages/shared/src/skills/storage.ts: global `GLOBAL_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR` (:473), workspace `loadWorkspaceSkills` (:478) and project `.agents/skills` / `PROJECT_AGENT_SKILLS_DIR` (:37, :485, :523), before plugin skills are folded in by `mergePluginSkills` (:494). Project subagents come from `.claude/agents` (packages/shared/src/capabilities/project-contribution-detect.ts:215). The only gate on the project tier is `projectTrusted` (storage.ts:484) - the per-user project-trust consent flow, a USER decision, which is exactly what this admin key exists to remove. `allowedPluginKeys`/`deniedPluginKeys`/`enabledPlugins` narrow plugins only and cannot reach these tiers.

So the correct statement of the gap is narrower than 'the key is absent': the hooks surface is reachable by other keys, the mcp surface is a recorded non-implementation, and what actually has no expression in our managed schema is an administrator's ability to force SKILLS and AGENTS to plugin-or-managed origin. Not one of the nine owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3, not a rebrand or scope-drop artifact, and absent from both the deviation register and the parity report. Same underlying gap as verdict f017 (found via permissions.md:507) - file once, not twice.
